debugTracePanel.intro: Tracing records one span per request by default. Debug tracing adds a span per pipeline stage and per source call, with SQL text. It adds load, so turn it on for one org, role or source for a set time; it turns itself off when the time is up.
debugTracePanel.hintIntro: A request can ask for a debug trace of itself with the @debugTrace directive, a "@provisa trace=debug" comment, or the X-Provisa-Trace: debug header. Requests from roles not listed here that carry the hint are rejected.
debugTracePanel.noHintRoles: No role is permitted the hint.
debugTracePanel.loadFailed: Could not load debug tracing settings
